evidence.quote: There are two methods of ingesting metrics into your Amazon Managed Service for Prometheus workspace.

**Using an AWS managed collector** – Amazon Managed Service for Prometheus provides a fully-managed, agentless scraper to automatically *scrape* metrics from your Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) clusters.

**Using a customer managed collector** – You have many options for managing your own collector. Two of the most common collectors to use are installing your own instance of Prometheus, running in agent mode, or using AWS Distro for OpenTelemetry.
